brief:
Weave the four overlay sweeps (proverbs, protocols, spells, sci-fi concepts) into the relationship map WEAVE.md — cross-dimension threads plus the casting-forward directions. Use after all four overlay-sweep outputs exist for a run.

Four inventories in, one fabric out.

A thread is a line through ALL FOUR dimensions (or honestly fewer, stated): a sci-fi concept that a proverb compresses, that a protocol operationalises, that a spell seals. Example shape:

> moving ceiling R(t) (F) → "the ceiling moves; the floor is proven" > (P) → GR-7 in-passage conditioning (R) → T∫ tracer glyph (S)

1. Read the four sweeps. Build the candidate threads from their    `threads:` cross-references; confirm or cut each (?) guess against    the anchors — a thread inherits the WEAKEST evidence of its links. 2. Write each confirmed thread as a section: the four (or fewer) beads    named, the anchors carried over, one paragraph of weave (poetic    register), and its **casting-forward direction** — stated as a    choosable act: a paper, an instrument, a ceremony, a post. 3.
